lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, forming a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating anchor nodes of peak luminance at the points of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear features on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with the brightest pixels on the superior edge and distinct shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 10-12 high-intensity blobs are distributed within the dorsal fin's silhouette, primarily clustered along the lower half and leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated silhouette representing a symbiotic fish (remora) is visible ventrally beneath the posterior region of the pectoral fin.
